```{r}
# Urban inadequate sanitation, 2010–2022
# Run after the temporal-comparison QMD has created:
# census_data_2010_domicilio, census_data_2022_domicilios,
# lookup_2010, lookup_2022, black_brown_2010_common,
# black_brown_2022_common, and income_2022_common.

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

# Exclude a tract from both sanitation counts when any relevant
# sanitation value is missing; missing values are never changed to zero.
sanitation_2010_tract <- census_data_2010_domicilio |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(
    id_2010 = as.character(code_tract),
    households = as.numeric(domicilio01_V002),
    pit = as.numeric(domicilio01_V019),
    ditch = as.numeric(domicilio01_V020),
    water_body = as.numeric(domicilio01_V021),
    no_bathroom_toilet = as.numeric(domicilio01_V023)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    inadequate_sanitation = pit + ditch + water_body + no_bathroom_toilet
  ) |>
  mutate(
    usable = is.finite(households) & households > 0 &
      is.finite(pit) & pit >= 0 &
      is.finite(ditch) & ditch >= 0 &
      is.finite(water_body) & water_body >= 0 &
      is.finite(no_bathroom_toilet) & no_bathroom_toilet >= 0 &
      inadequate_sanitation <= households
  )

sanitation_2022_tract <- census_data_2022_domicilios |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(
    id_2022 = as.character(code_tract),
    households = as.numeric(domicilio01_V00001),
    pit = as.numeric(domicilio02_V00312),
    ditch = as.numeric(domicilio02_V00313),
    water_body = as.numeric(domicilio02_V00314),
    no_bathroom_toilet =
      as.numeric(domicilio02_V00307) + as.numeric(domicilio02_V00308)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    inadequate_sanitation = pit + ditch + water_body + no_bathroom_toilet
  ) |>
  mutate(
    usable = is.finite(households) & households > 0 &
      is.finite(pit) & pit >= 0 &
      is.finite(ditch) & ditch >= 0 &
      is.finite(water_body) & water_body >= 0 &
      is.finite(no_bathroom_toilet) & no_bathroom_toilet >= 0 &
      inadequate_sanitation <= households
  )

make_common_sanitation <- function(data, lookup, id_column, year) {
  keys <- lookup |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    transmute(
      id = as.character(.data[[id_column]]),
      common_id = as.character(common_id)
    ) |>
    distinct()
  
  data |>
    rename(id = all_of(id_column)) |>
    left_join(keys, by = "id") |>
    filter(!is.na(common_id)) |>
    group_by(common_id) |>
    summarise(
      households = sum(households[usable], na.rm = TRUE),
      inadequate_sanitation = sum(inadequate_sanitation[usable], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(year = year)
}

sanitation_2010_common <- make_common_sanitation(
  sanitation_2010_tract, lookup_2010, "id_2010", 2010L
)

sanitation_2022_common <- make_common_sanitation(
  sanitation_2022_tract, lookup_2022, "id_2022", 2022L
)

# Retain only common areas whose component 2022 tracts are all urban.
urban_common_ids <- census_data_2022_domicilios |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(
    id_2022 = as.character(code_tract),
    urban_2022 = !is.na(situacao) & situacao == "Urbana"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    lookup_2022 |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      transmute(
        id_2022 = as.character(id_2022),
        common_id = as.character(common_id)
      ) |>
      distinct(),
    by = "id_2022"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(common_id)) |>
  group_by(common_id) |>
  summarise(entirely_urban_2022 = all(urban_2022), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(entirely_urban_2022) |>
  select(common_id)

racial_long <- bind_rows(
  black_brown_2010_common |>
    transmute(
      common_id = as.character(common_id),
      year = 2010L,
      racial_share = black_brown_ratio_2010
    ),
  black_brown_2022_common |>
    transmute(
      common_id = as.character(common_id),
      year = 2022L,
      racial_share = black_brown_ratio_2022
    )
)

chart_data <- racial_long |>
  inner_join(
    bind_rows(sanitation_2010_common, sanitation_2022_common),
    by = c("common_id", "year")
  ) |>
  semi_join(urban_common_ids, by = "common_id") |>
  filter(
    is.finite(racial_share), between(racial_share, 0, 1),
    is.finite(households), households > 0,
    is.finite(inadequate_sanitation), inadequate_sanitation >= 0,
    inadequate_sanitation <= households
  )

chart_data_2022 <- chart_data |>
  filter(year == 2022L)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(chart_data_2022$common_id))

paired_ids <- chart_data |>
  count(common_id) |>
  filter(n == 2) |>
  select(common_id)

chart_data <- chart_data |>
  semi_join(paired_ids, by = "common_id")

quintiles_2022 <- chart_data |>
  filter(year == 2022L) |>
  arrange(racial_share, common_id) |>
  transmute(
    common_id,
    racial_quintile = ntile(racial_share, 5)
  )

chart_data <- chart_data |>
  inner_join(quintiles_2022, by = "common_id")

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(chart_data[c("common_id", "year")]))

year_summary <- chart_data |>
  group_by(year, racial_quintile) |>
  summarise(
    households = sum(households),
    percentage = 100 * sum(inadequate_sanitation) / sum(households),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

format_pp <- function(value) {
  rounded <- round(value, 1)
  ifelse(
    rounded == 0,
    "0.0 pp",
    paste0(
      ifelse(rounded > 0, "+", "−"),
      sprintf("%.1f", abs(rounded)),
      " pp"
    )
  )
}

paired_summary <- year_summary |>
  select(year, racial_quintile, percentage) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = percentage,
    names_prefix = "pct_"
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(pct_2010),
    is.finite(pct_2022)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference = pct_2022 - pct_2010,
    difference_label = format_pp(difference),
    label_y = pmax(pct_2010, pct_2022) + 2.2,
    racial_quintile = factor(racial_quintile, levels = 1:5)
  )

# The diagnostic below confirms whether every quintile has a valid year pair.
# It is not used as a hard stop because sparse subsets can omit a group.

point_data <- paired_summary |>
  select(racial_quintile, pct_2010, pct_2022) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pct_"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "percentage"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = recode(year, pct_2010 = "2010", pct_2022 = "2022"),
    year = factor(year, levels = c("2010", "2022"))
  )

quintile_ranges <- chart_data |>
  filter(year == 2022L) |>
  group_by(racial_quintile) |>
  summarise(
    lower = min(racial_share),
    upper = max(racial_share),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    racial_quintile = factor(racial_quintile, levels = 1:5),
    label = paste0(
      "Q", racial_quintile,
      "\n", sprintf("%.1f–%.1f%%", 100 * lower, 100 * upper)
    )
  )

quintile_labels <- setNames(
  quintile_ranges$label,
  quintile_ranges$racial_quintile
)

year_colours <- c("2010" = "#B4516C", "2022" = "#087F86")

y_max <- max(
  60,
  ceiling((max(paired_summary$label_y, na.rm = TRUE) + 5) / 10) * 10
)

p_change <- ggplot(paired_summary, aes(x = racial_quintile)) +
  geom_point(
    data = point_data |> filter(year == "2022"),
    aes(y = percentage, fill = year),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    stroke = 0.9,
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  # Arrow is above the 2022 dot but below the 2010 dot. Q1 has no arrow.
  geom_segment(
    data = paired_summary |> filter(racial_quintile != "1"),
    aes(
      xend = racial_quintile,
      y = pct_2010,
      yend = pct_2022
    ),
    colour = "#7FA8AD",
    linewidth = 0.75,
    arrow = grid::arrow(
      type = "closed",
      angle = 20,
      length = grid::unit(2.2, "mm")
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = point_data |> filter(year == "2010"),
    aes(y = percentage, fill = year),
    shape = 22,
    size = 5,
    stroke = 0.9,
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = label_y, label = difference_label),
    size = 3.7,
    colour = "#405660"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = year_colours) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = quintile_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, y_max),
    breaks = seq(0, y_max, 10),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Inadequate sanitation in urban areas, 2010–2022",
    subtitle = "Based on common areas with data in both census years.",
    x = "Black/Brown population share in an area",
    y = "Households with inadequate sanitation (%)",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Inadequate sanitation: rudimentary pit, ditch, or water-body disposal, or no bathroom or toilet.",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", colour = "#19343E"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "#526772", margin = margin(t = 5, b = 16)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#607580", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 14)),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#E5EBED", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "#405660"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, lineheight = 0.95),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "#405660"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 18)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 14)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.margin = margin(18, 20, 16, 14)
  )

p_change

# ============================================================
# CHART 2 — Sanitation inequalities within income bands, 2022
# ============================================================

# Uses the same urban common areas as Chart 1. Income is the 2022
# household-head income already aggregated to common comparison areas
# in the temporal-comparison QMD.
income_2022_for_chart <- income_2022_common |>
  transmute(
    common_id = as.character(common_id),
    income = as.numeric(income_2022)
  )

income_all_2022 <- chart_data_2022 |>
  inner_join(income_2022_for_chart, by = "common_id") |>
  filter(is.finite(income), income >= 0) |>
  mutate(
    sanitation_percentage = 100 * inadequate_sanitation / households
  )

if (nrow(income_all_2022) == 0L) {
  stop("No urban common areas have valid 2022 sanitation and income data.")
}

# Income bands are defined from every eligible urban 2022 area, before
# restricting the boxplots to Q1 and Q5.
income_cutoffs <- quantile(
  income_all_2022$income,
  probs = c(1 / 3, 2 / 3),
  names = FALSE
)

if (any(!is.finite(income_cutoffs)) || income_cutoffs[1] >= income_cutoffs[2]) {
  stop("The 2022 income distribution cannot be split into three income bands.")
}

format_brl <- function(value) {
  paste0("R$ ", format(round(value), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE))
}

income_band_annotations <- tibble(
  income_band = factor(
    c("Lower income", "Middle income", "Higher income"),
    levels = c("Lower income", "Middle income", "Higher income")
  ),
  label = c(
    paste0("≤ ", format_brl(income_cutoffs[1])),
    paste0(format_brl(income_cutoffs[1]), "–", format_brl(income_cutoffs[2])),
    paste0("> ", format_brl(income_cutoffs[2]))
  )
)

racial_quintiles_2022 <- chart_data_2022 |>
  arrange(racial_share, common_id) |>
  transmute(
    common_id,
    racial_quintile = ntile(racial_share, 5)
  )

racial_quintile_ranges <- chart_data_2022 |>
  inner_join(racial_quintiles_2022, by = "common_id") |>
  filter(racial_quintile %in% c(1, 5)) |>
  group_by(racial_quintile) |>
  summarise(
    lower = min(racial_share),
    upper = max(racial_share),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    racial_quintile = factor(racial_quintile, levels = c(1, 5)),
    label = paste0(
      if_else(racial_quintile == "1", "Q1 · Lowest", "Q5 · Highest"),
      "\n", sprintf("%.1f–%.1f%%", 100 * lower, 100 * upper)
    )
  )

racial_quintile_labels <- setNames(
  racial_quintile_ranges$label,
  racial_quintile_ranges$racial_quintile
)

income_box_data <- income_all_2022 |>
  inner_join(racial_quintiles_2022, by = "common_id") |>
  filter(racial_quintile %in% c(1, 5)) |>
  mutate(
    income_band = cut(
      income,
      breaks = c(-Inf, income_cutoffs, Inf),
      labels = c("Lower income", "Middle income", "Higher income"),
      right = TRUE
    ),
    racial_quintile = factor(racial_quintile, levels = c(1, 5))
  )

p_income_boxplots <- ggplot(
  income_box_data,
  aes(x = racial_quintile, y = sanitation_percentage)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.56,
    fill = "#E5EFF0",
    colour = "#087F86",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = income_band_annotations,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = 106, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.7,
    colour = "#607580"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~income_band, nrow = 1, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = racial_quintile_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 110),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Inadequate sanitation in urban areas, 2022",
    subtitle = "By income band and Black/Brown population share.",
    x = "Black/Brown population share in an area",
    y = "Households with inadequate sanitation (%)",
    caption = paste(
      "Boxes show only the lowest and highest 2022 racial-composition quintiles; income bands use all eligible urban areas.",
      "Inadequate sanitation: rudimentary pit, ditch, or water-body disposal, or no bathroom or toilet.",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", colour = "#19343E"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, colour = "#526772", margin = margin(t = 5, b = 16)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#607580", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 14)),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", colour = "#19343E", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#E5EBED", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.4, "lines"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "#405660"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, lineheight = 0.95),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "#405660"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 18)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 12)),
    plot.margin = margin(18, 20, 16, 14)
  )

p_income_boxplots

ggsave(
  "urban_inadequate_sanitation_income_boxplots_2022.png",
  plot = p_income_boxplots,
  width = 14,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

```
